titulo: The Flatwoods Monster Came Back for My Grandpa 👽 #Shorts
titulo_pt: O Monstro de Flatwoods voltou pelo meu avô
resumo_pt: O avô dizia que viu o Monstro de Flatwoods quando criança, em 1952. Setenta anos depois uma luz cai no mesmo morro e o neto sobe para ver o monstro. O avô aparece de pijama, sorrindo: ele não tinha sido testemunha, era o passageiro que a criatura deixou para trás, e agora vai embora com ela.
descricao:
Grandpa always said he saw it as a kid. He left out the most important part.

Would you have climbed that hill?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.
personagens: the narrator is a young man in his twenties with short brown hair, a stubble beard and a red flannel shirt; Grandpa is a thin man in his eighties with white hair, glasses and blue striped pajamas; the Flatwoods Monster is ten feet tall, with a huge dark spade-shaped hood around a round red face, two glowing white eyes, and a dark green metallic skirt-like body that floats above the ground

scenes.text: Grandpa's rule: when lights fall on the hill, stay inside.
scenes.pt: A regra do meu avô: se cair luz no morro, fique dentro de casa.
scenes.visual: Grandpa in his armchair pointing a finger at a window, a dark West Virginia hill outside

scenes.text: Last night, one fell. Something tall stood up.
scenes.pt: Ontem à noite, uma caiu. Algo alto se levantou.
scenes.visual: the Flatwoods Monster standing on a dark hilltop in a red glow, glowing white eyes, spade-shaped hood

scenes.text: Ten feet tall. A spade-shaped hood.
scenes.pt: Três metros de altura. Um capuz em forma de espada de baralho.
scenes.visual: low angle of the Flatwoods Monster towering in the dark, its huge spade-shaped hood against the stars
close up of the Flatwoods Monster's round red face with two glowing white eyes

scenes.text: Grandpa said he saw it as a kid, in nineteen fifty-two.
scenes.pt: O avô dizia que viu aquilo quando criança, em 1952.
scenes.visual: Grandpa alone at a dark window, staring at the red glow on the hill

scenes.text: I climbed the hill alone with a flashlight.
scenes.pt: Subi o morro sozinho com uma lanterna.
scenes.visual: the narrator alone climbing a grassy hill at night with a flashlight, red glow above

scenes.pt: Uma névoa com gosto de metal queimou minha garganta.
scenes.visual: the narrator alone coughing in thick glowing mist on the hilltop

scenes.text: It hissed and floated toward me.
scenes.pt: Ele chiou e flutuou na minha direção.
scenes.visual: the Flatwoods Monster gliding through the mist toward the narrator, eyes blazing

scenes.text: I froze. Its eyes burned through me.
scenes.pt: Eu congelei. Os olhos dele me queimavam por dentro.
scenes.visual: the narrator frozen in terror, wide eyes, lit by the monster's white glow

scenes.text: It stopped. It looked past me.
scenes.pt: Ele parou. Olhou para trás de mim.
scenes.visual: the Flatwoods Monster tilting its hooded head, looking past the narrator down the hill

scenes.text: Grandpa walked up the hill in pajamas.
scenes.pt: O avô subiu o morro de pijama.
scenes.visual: Grandpa in blue striped pajamas walking up the dark hill toward the glow

scenes.text: He wasn't scared. He was smiling.
scenes.pt: Ele não estava com medo. Estava sorrindo.
scenes.visual: close up of Grandpa smiling peacefully, his glasses reflecting red light
Grandpa facing the Flatwoods Monster on the hilltop, looking up at it

scenes.text: It lowered its hood to him. Like a bow.
scenes.pt: A criatura abaixou o capuz para ele. Como uma reverência.
scenes.visual: the Flatwoods Monster bowing its spade-shaped hood toward Grandpa, the narrator watching behind them

scenes.text: Grandpa stepped into the light. Then darkness.
scenes.pt: O avô entrou na luz. Depois, escuridão.
scenes.visual: Grandpa and the Flatwoods Monster vanishing into a column of red light on the hilltop

scenes.text: Grandpa wasn't just a witness back then.
scenes.pt: O avô não foi só uma testemunha naquela época.
scenes.visual: Grandpa's empty armchair at dawn, an old pair of glasses on the seat

scenes.text: He was the passenger it left behind.
scenes.pt: Ele era o passageiro que a criatura deixou para trás.
scenes.visual: a scorched circle in the grass on the empty hilltop at sunrise, the narrator alone staring at it
